steps.title: One half and one whole

options.label: Which picture has one of two equal parts coloured?
Fourteen counters are shared equally between two groups. Build one half.
Put the two equal halves back together. What have we made?

steps.hint: Count the equal parts in the whole, then the coloured parts.
steps.explanation: Connect ½ to an equal part, a fair share and a complete whole.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: One half and one whole
mathWorkshop.goal: Connect ½ to an equal part, a fair share and a complete whole.

tasks.prompt: Which picture has one of two equal parts coloured?
tasks.feedback: A shows one half: one of two equal parts. B shows one of four equal parts.
tasks.hint: Count the equal parts in the whole, then the coloured parts.

tasks.prompt: Fourteen counters are shared equally between two groups. Build one half.
tasks.feedback: Seven and seven make fourteen, so half of fourteen is seven.
tasks.hint: Both groups must get the same number. Check that your share doubled makes fourteen.

tasks.prompt: Put the two equal halves back together. What have we made?
tasks.feedback: Two halves of the same thing join to make one whole.
tasks.hint: The complete shape is one whole, even though a dividing line remains.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Writing a half
steps.prompt: Choose how to write one half.
steps.hint: A half is 1 part out of 2.
steps.explanation: One over two means one of two equal parts.
steps.shortExplanation: One over two means one of two equal parts.

steps.title: Half coloured
steps.prompt: Choose all shapes with one half coloured.
steps.hint: Is the coloured part one of two equal parts?
steps.explanation: a and c have half coloured. b has only one of four equal parts coloured.
steps.shortExplanation: a and c have half coloured. b has only one of four equal parts coloured.

source.answerKeyText: a and c. In b, only one of four parts is coloured.

steps.title: Two halves
steps.hint: Put two halves of a pizza back together.
steps.explanation: Putting two equal halves together makes the whole again.
steps.shortExplanation: Putting two equal halves together makes the whole again.

steps.title: Half a team
steps.prompt: Half a team is 5 children. How many are in the whole team?
steps.hint: If one half is 5, what is the other half?
steps.explanation: Five children are one half. Another five make the whole team of 10.
steps.shortExplanation: Five children are one half. Another five make the whole team of 10.

steps.title: Try it at home
steps.prompt: With an adult, draw a cake and one line that divides it into two equal halves.
steps.hint: One half is one of two equal parts. Share the group equally.
steps.explanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.
steps.shortExplanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.

source.answerKeyText: Any cake with one line making two equal parts.

parentReview.en: Any cake with one line making two equal parts.
parentReview.note: Discuss with an adult; this personal or drawing response is not automatically graded.

steps.title: Showing ½
steps.hint: Do the two parts have to be the same size?
steps.explanation: ½ is one of two equal parts, as in picture a.
steps.shortExplanation: ½ is one of two equal parts, as in picture a.

steps.title: Half of 16
steps.explanation: Eight and eight make 16, so half of 16 is 8.
steps.shortExplanation: Eight and eight make 16, so half of 16 is 8.

steps.title: Halves together
steps.hint: Put the two halves back together.
steps.explanation: Two halves together make one whole.
steps.shortExplanation: Two halves together make one whole.

steps.title: Half of 18
steps.explanation: Nine and nine make 18, so half of 18 is 9.
steps.shortExplanation: Nine and nine make 18, so half of 18 is 9.

steps.title: Middle of a string
steps.prompt: To find the middle of a string...
steps.hint: How could you make both parts exactly the same?
steps.explanation: Folding the ends together finds the middle exactly.
steps.shortExplanation: Folding the ends together finds the middle exactly.

stickers.meaning: The complete thing before it is cut.

homeActivities.text: Fold a ribbon in half with an adult. Share 12, 14, 16, 18 or 20 large counters into two equal groups. Write one half as ½.
homeActivities.textAr: اطبقوا شريطة من النص مع حد كبير. قسّموا ١٢ أو ١٤ أو ١٦ أو ١٨ أو ٢٠ حتة كبيرة لمجموعتين متساويتين. واكتبوا «نص» بالرقم: ½.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.
